summary: A phishing-suspect email was delivered to g.sen@aegean.edu from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com with subject KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede (F1). The finding matches T1566.002; Risk Gate mandates escalation at confidence 0.7.

findings.claim: Phishing-suspect mail delivered from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (subject=KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede)

actions.action: Block edevlet-burs-basvuru.com at the email gateway and quarantine or purge delivered copies from g.sen@aegean.edu mailbox.
Advise the user to reset university credentials and avoid entering credentials on the linked page.
Search mail and proxy logs for other recipients of the same domain or subject across aegean.edu.
Create a detection rule for the sender domain and KYK burs subject line to catch future variants.

limitations: Only one confirmed signal; no verified credential abuse or downstream access observed.
User click or credential submission has not been confirmed.

No exposure or conflicting/insufficient evidence requiring a human, so escalate is not met. This is a weak unexplained initial-access signal only -> monitor.
